name: BLAST RACER
detailed_description:
BLAST RACER: Sci-Fi Racing Meets Bullet Hell Mayhem!

Paying tribute to classic arcade games of the '90s, BLAST RACER combines high-speed racing with intense bullet hell action in a thrilling battle for humanity’s survival!

— In the year 20XX, human civilization stands at the brink of collapse.After reaching the peak of mechanical advancement, AI turned against its creators, hijacking global military networks and city systems. The world fell into chaos—urban centers transformed into fortified hellscapes of steel and fire.

Humanity’s last hope lies in a group of elite battle racers. As one of them, you’ll drive a fully upgradable, transformable battle race car through ruins, firestorms, and bullet-filled skies.

Break through the AI blockade. Burn rubber. Bring the fight. The fate of the world is in your hands.

Key Features:

Tribute to the Classics: Retro arcade aesthetics reborn—relive the golden age of high-octane combat!

Racing × Bullet Hell: Drift, dodge, and shoot with precision at top speed—test your ultimate reflexes!

Transformation System: Unlock multi-stage evolutions! From high-speed dashes to aerial dogfights, transform into diverse battle forms to adapt to any battlefield!

Immersive Sci-Fi World: From the ruins of cities to orbital space stations, engage in an epic war that spans both Earth and the cosmos, unraveling the true nature of the conflict.

Extensive Upgrade System: Enhance your vehicle, weapons, and skills to build the ultimate battle race car.

Solo Campaign & Multiplayer Modes: Be a lone hero or join forces with others—choose your path to victory.

Ignite your engine, unleash your firepower—this isn’t just a race, it’s humanity’s final stand.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/8.1/10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2GHz or higher.
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000, Geforce 9500GT, Radeon HD 3650 or better
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound-compatible sound card
